	// interpolated from the end-of-last-tic pose for free, with no bookkeeping. The saber hands us a
	// PREDICTED pose so that slide lands on the LIVE hand instead of a tic behind it.
	// jump:  no usable history to slide from -- clear the interpolation so nothing ghost-sweeps in.
	// snapA / snapL: no slide this tic for the turn / for the position (a stop, a reversal, or coming to rest).
	// THE HILT TAKES snapA EXACTLY AS THE BEAM DOES, on purpose. A one-frame angular snap on an opaque object
	// is more visible than on a symmetrical glow, and letting the hilt keep its angular slide here was
	// considered -- but the whole point of this change is that the hilt and the beam cannot disagree, and the
	// tics snapA fires on are the hardest swings, which is precisely where a disagreement would show. If the
	// hilt pops at the end of hard swings, the knob is ubqs_glow_lead (lower it): that shrinks the lead, and
	// therefore any snap, for the hilt and the beam together.
	void Place(Vector3 from, double ya, double pit, double rol, double sc, int spr, int frm, bool jump, bool snapA = false, bool snapL = false)
	{
		// Prev is where the hilt was drawn at the end of last tic -- the engine set it so this tic; said again
		// here so the slide always starts from the last PLACED pose even if this is called twice before a draw.
		Prev = pos;
		Vector3 oldPos = pos;
		pYaw = angle;
		pPitch = pitch;
		pRoll = roll;
		// moving:true, always. SetOrigin(pos, false) calls ClearInterpolation and snaps Prev to here
		// (p_maputl.cpp:563-571), which would delete the slide this whole design is built on.
		SetOrigin(from, true);
		// the default sprite type (RF_FACESPRITE == 0) subtracts Floorclip from a MODEL's z
		// (hw_sprites.cpp:939) and it is read raw with no interpolation, so it has to stay at zero. SetOrigin
		// runs P_FindFloorCeiling, so this is said after it, not before. (A +NOINTERACTION actor should never
		// be floorclipped in the first place; this is one line of insurance against a liquid floor.)
		Floorclip = 0;
		// (ya + 180, -180 - pit, rol + 180) IS THE SAME POSE -- an exact identity of the renderer's full
		// rotate(-angle, Y) rotate(pitch, Z) rotate(-roll, X) chain (models.cpp:169-171), checked numerically
		// over the whole 3x3, not merely of one axis -- so it transfers to a fully oriented hilt and not just
		// to a symmetrical shell. Take whichever is nearer the last pose and the engine's per-axis angle lerp
		// (deltaangle, wrap-safe) never swings the long way round. This is the guard for the near-vertical
		// guard pose, where yaw and roll are ill-conditioned and one tic would otherwise sweep the entire
		// saber round the player.
		double c0 = abs(DeltaAngle(angle, ya)) + abs(DeltaAngle(pitch, pit)) + abs(DeltaAngle(roll, rol));
		double c1 = abs(DeltaAngle(angle, ya + 180.0)) + abs(DeltaAngle(pitch, -180.0 - pit)) + abs(DeltaAngle(roll, rol + 180.0));
		if (c1 < c0) { ya += 180.0; pit = -180.0 - pit; rol += 180.0; }
		angle = Normalize180(ya);
		pitch = Normalize180(pit);
		roll = Normalize180(rol);
		// ONE uniform number is the whole size: Scale.X drives md3 x AND md3 y while Scale.Y drives md3 z
		// (models.cpp:85-87), and the world MODELDEF blocks are Scale 1 1 1 / 1 -1 1, carrying only the
		// handedness sign. NO level.pixelstretch factor here, unlike UBQS_BeamGlow.Place: the world saber
		// blocks declare CorrectPixelStretch, which puts the 1/pixelstretch squash in WORLD space where the
		// hand matrix put it (hw_openxrdevice.cpp:448). BeamGlow's old `* level.pixelstretch` only ever
		// existed to undo a MODEL-space squash its own blocks could not avoid -- and it is deleted in this
		// same change, for the same reason.
		scale = (sc, sc);
		// MODELDEF is keyed on (class, sprite, frame) -- models.cpp:1313 -- and the world draw reads
		// actor->sprite / actor->frame directly (hw_sprites.cpp:885), so this is how the size, the colour, one
		// blade or two and the animation frame are all chosen every tic.
		sprite = spr;
		frame = frm;
		if (jump || snapA)
		{
			// the angles can only be cleared together with the position -- ClearInterpolation is the ONLY
			// handle on PrevAngles, which ZScript cannot see (actorinlines.h:29-35) -- so clear both, then
			// hand the position its slide back unless it is stopping too.
			ClearInterpolation();
			if (!jump && !snapL) Prev = oldPos;
			pYaw = angle;
			pPitch = pitch;
			pRoll = roll;
		}
		else if (snapL) Prev = pos;
		if (jump) { pYaw = angle; pPitch = pitch; pRoll = roll; }
	}
	States
	{
	// A REAL FOUR-CHARACTER SPRITE, NEVER TNT1. Sprite index 0 is rejected at hw_sprites.cpp:793, BEFORE the
	// model lookup is ever reached, so a `TNT1 A -1` parking state draws nothing however correct the MODELDEF
	// is -- it is the one silent way to kill a world model. -1 duration so SetState never runs again and never
	// overwrites the sprite Place() assigns each tic (p_mobj.cpp:575-584). The actor is placed in the same tic
	// it spawns, so it is never actually drawn as UBWS; the name only has to EXIST, because MODELDEF aborts
	// the load on a sprite name no state uses (models.cpp:1199) -- and this state is what registers the one
	// name the world blocks do not share with the psprite saber. It needs no lump of its own: the "sprite has
	// no frames" error at models.cpp:1189-1192 is commented out, and the world draw never reaches the texture
	// path when a model was found (hw_sprites.cpp:958).
	Spawn:
		UBWS A -1;
		Stop;
	}
}
// THE OFF HAND IS USUALLY THE MIRRORED ONE -- but which hand the engine reflects depends on
// vr_control_scheme, so the choice is made per spawn by UBQS_Data.WorldMirror and not by bOffhandWeapon.
// COUNTING THE REFLECTIONS IN THE HUD CHAIN: hw_openxrdevice.cpp:442's scale(vu, vu, -vu) is one; the saber
// block's negative xscale is one; and hw_vrmodes.cpp:468's scale(-1, 1, 1) is a third that fires only for the
// hand whose PHYSICAL index is 0 -- the OFF hand under the default right-handed vr_control_scheme (< 10) and
// the MAIN hand under a left-handed one (hw_vrmodes.cpp:464-465, and the header comment at
// hw_openxrdevice.cpp:425-429 confirms index 0 = left = offhand). So the drawn saber has EVEN parity on the
// hand the engine leaves alone and ODD parity on the hand it reflects. Determinant sign is a rotation
// invariant, so the world copy must match: Scale 1 1 1 on the first, Scale 1 -1 1 on the second.
// THE NEGATIVE IS ON YSCALE, WHICH IS md3 FILE Y, THE HILT'S LATERAL AXIS, and not on xscale: solving the two
// chains against each other, the handedness difference falls on matrix slot 3, which models.cpp:188 feeds
// from scaleFactorY = Scale.X * yscale = md3 file Y. Negating file X instead also verifies, but only with
// angle = HA()+180, pitch = -HP(), roll = -HR(), which splits the angle formulas between the hands for
// nothing. Swapping the two classes puts the hilt's lateral axis 180 degrees out on BOTH hands.
// NEGATIVE ACTOR Scale.X IS NOT AN ESCAPE HATCH: Scale.X feeds BOTH lateral axes (models.cpp:85-86), so it
// gives a 180-degree rotation, not a reflection -- which is why this has to be a second class with its own
// blocks at all.
// KEEPING THE PARITY IS ALSO WHAT KEEPS UBQS_Data.BladeDirOf CORRECT UNCHANGED -- its `m = off ? 1.0 : -1.0`
// was validated in the headset on 10-01 against the drawn object's net handedness, and this recipe preserves
// that net handedness, so nothing downstream of the pose needs touching.
// MODELDEF DOES NOT INHERIT -- the lookup is exact PClass pointer identity (models.cpp:1313) and a subclass's
// `hasmodel` is memcpy'd from the parent (info.cpp:486) before MODELDEF is parsed (d_main.cpp:3460 before
// :3486) -- so this empty subclass needs its OWN full set of blocks, exactly as UBQS_Saber and UBQS_SaberOff
// already do. See modeldefRule.
class UBQS_WorldSaberOff : UBQS_WorldSaber {}

class UBQS_ClashFlash : Actor
{
	int life;
	double grow;
	Default
	{
		RenderStyle "Add";
		Alpha 1.0;
		Scale 0.12;
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+BRIGHT
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+FORCEXYBILLBOARD
		+ROLLSPRITE
	}
	static void Burst(Vector3 at, double size)
	{
		UBQS_FX.Fx(at, 'UXST', 1, 7, 0.09 * size, 1.0, -1, 1.0 + 0.1 * size);
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		if (--life <= 0) { Destroy(); return; }
		scale *= grow;
		alpha = life / 6.0;
	}
	States { Spawn: UBCF A -1 Bright; Stop; }
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE THROWN SABER: a real model in the room. Hold alt to paint up to ubqs_locks enemies in front of your
// hand, let go to throw -- it flies to each in turn, Captain America style, cutting them, then comes home.
// Nothing painted: it flies straight out to ubqs_throw_range. It spins in the plane you choose (ubqs_throw_plane:
// your wrist decides, flat like a disc, or end over end), lights its second blade as it leaves your hand,
// turns shots it passes, and burns a trail into any wall or floor its blades touch. Then (ubqs_throw 0) it
// comes back to your hand, or (1) drops: a saber that drops, or cannot get home, falls, lies flat and SHUTS
// OFF. Fire or alt fire calls it back -- a Force pull: it lights, lifts and flies to you. Walk over it to take it.
//
// IT MOVES ITSELF, with TryMove and +THRUACTORS: monsters do not stop it (the spinning blade cuts them),
// walls do. The engine's own Tick still runs every tic with no speed, so the renderer has last tic's position
// and angles and slides the model between them -- a 90 Hz spin, not a 35 Hz one.
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Thrown : Actor
{
	enum EPhase { PH_OUT, PH_ROUTE, PH_HOME, PH_FALL, PH_REST, PH_PULL }

	UBQS_SaberBase launcher;
	int    col;
	bool   dbl;
	double bladeLen;
	int    phase;
	int    age, phaseAge;
	Array<Actor> route;
	int    leg;
	bool   legHit;
	Vector3 dir;              // where it is flying, unit
	double flown;
	double fallV;
	double range;
	Vector3 drift;            // a lob's sideways motion, as it falls
	bool   vertical;          // spin end over end (else flat, like a disc)
	double spinPhase;
	int    burnQuiet;
	private Array<Actor> cutWho;
	private Array<int>   cutWhen;
	private int    litRgb;
	private int    litRad;

	Default
	{
		Radius 6;
		Height 6;
		Speed 26;
		+NOGRAVITY
		+THRUACTORS
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTELEPORT
		+NOTRIGGER
		+DROPOFF
		+NOBLOCKMONST
		+INTERPOLATEANGLES
		DamageType "Saber";
		Obituary "%o was cut down by %k's thrown lightsaber.";
	}

	void Launch(Vector3 d, bool vert)
	{
		dir = d;
		vertical = vert;
		angle = VectorAngle(d.x, d.y);
		spinPhase = angle;
		leg = 0;
		SetPhase(route.Size() > 0 ? PH_ROUTE : PH_OUT);
		if (phase == PH_ROUTE) NextLeg(false);
	}

	// A LOB: let go with the hand barely moving -- it tumbles out of your hand and falls where it lands
	void Lob(Vector3 v)
	{
		dir = (v.Length() > 0.01) ? v.Unit() : (cos(angle), sin(angle), 0);
		vertical = true;
		drift = (v.x, v.y, 0);
		fallV = -max(v.z, 0.0);
		SetPhase(PH_FALL);
	}

	bool IsLit() { return phase != PH_REST && !(phase == PH_FALL && phaseAge >= 6); }
	private void SetPhase(int p) { phase = p; phaseAge = 0; }

	// THE FORCE PULL (fire or alt fire with the saber out of your hand)
	void Recall()
	{
		if (phase == PH_PULL || phase == PH_HOME) return;
		if (phase == PH_REST) A_StartSound(UBQS_Font.On(), CHAN_BODY, 0, 0.7);     // a dark saber relighting
		ClearRoute();
		SetPhase(PH_PULL);
	}

	private void ClearRoute()
	{
		route.Clear();
		UBQS_LockMark.ClearAll(launcher);
	}

	// THE NEXT LIVING TARGET ON THE ROUTE, or the way home when there are none left
	private void NextLeg(bool advance)
	{
		if (advance) leg++;
		legHit = false;
		cutWho.Clear();
		cutWhen.Clear();
		while (leg < route.Size())
		{
			Actor t = route[leg];
			if (t && t.health > 0 && t.bShootable) return;
			leg++;
		}
		ClearRoute();
		Done();
	}
	// THE THROW IS OVER: home, or down where it is (ubqs_throw)
	private void Done()
	{
		if (UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_throw", 0) == 0) SetPhase(PH_HOME);
		else { fallV = 0; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
	}

	override void Tick()
	{
		if (!launcher || !master || master.health <= 0 || launcher.owner != master)
		{
			// NOT ClearAll(null) -- a null launcher is one of the reasons we are in here, and ClearAll
			// reads null as every mark of every saber of every player.
			if (launcher) UBQS_LockMark.ClearAll(launcher);
			if (launcher && launcher.thrown == self) launcher.thrown = null;
			Destroy();
			return;
		}
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		age++;
		phaseAge++;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) burnQuiet--;
		if (age > 35 * 12 && phase < PH_HOME) { ClearRoute(); Done(); }
		double sp = Speed;
		switch (phase)
		{
		case PH_OUT:
			if (!Fly(dir * sp)) { Bang(); ClearRoute(); Done(); break; }
			flown += sp;
			if (flown >= (range > 0 ? range : UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_throw_range", 512.0))) Done();
			break;
		case PH_ROUTE:
		{
			Actor t = (leg < route.Size()) ? route[leg] : null;
			if (!t || t.health <= 0 || legHit) { NextLeg(true); break; }
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(pos, (t.pos.xy, t.pos.z + t.height * 0.5));
			double d = to.Length();
			if (d < t.radius + 10.0) { legHit = true; break; }
			dir = to / max(d, 0.001);
			// a wall in the way: it slips past (the Force), rather than drop the route
			bNoClip = false;
			if (!Fly(dir * min(sp * 1.15, d)))
			{
				Bang();
				bNoClip = true;
				Fly(dir * min(sp, d));
			}
			else bNoClip = false;
			break;
		}
		case PH_HOME:
		case PH_PULL:
		{
			// HOME, to the hand wherever it has gone. Through walls if it must: the Force does not path-find.
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(pos, launcher.HandPos());
			// NEVER DIVIDE BY IT. Once the step is min(hs, d) == d the saber lands exactly on the hand
			// point, so d really does reach 0 whenever two tics read the same pose (a hitch) -- and to / d
			// then poisons dir, step and the actor's own position with NaN, with no PH_PULL timeout to
			// recover from it: the hilt is gone for the rest of the level. PH_ROUTE already guards this.
			double d = max(to.Length(), 0.001);
			// IT HAS TO HAVE LEFT BEFORE IT CAN COME BACK. Catch() fires inside 26 units and the saber is
			// SPAWNED at the hand, so a throw that ends at once is already inside its own catch radius:
			// catch, destroy, return to hand, thrown again next release -- a hilt flickering at the hand.
			// ONLY THE CATCH WAITS. An earlier build put this test above the movement, which stopped the
			// saber flying at all for its first 17 tics and left it hanging in the air.
			if (d < 26.0 && age >= 17) { Catch(); return; }
			double hs = (phase == PH_PULL) ? min(10.0 + phaseAge * 2.0, 34.0) : 30.0;
			Vector3 step = to / d * min(hs, d);
			if (phase == PH_PULL && phaseAge < 8) step = (0, 0, 3.0);        // it lifts off the floor first
			else dir = to / d;
			bNoClip = true;
			Fly(step);
			if (phase == PH_HOME && phaseAge > 140) { fallV = 0; bNoClip = false; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
			break;
		}
		case PH_FALL:
		{
			bNoClip = false;
			if (drift.Length() > 0.05)
			{
				if (!TryMove(pos.xy + drift.xy, true)) drift = (0, 0, 0);
				drift *= 0.92;
			}
			fallV = min(fallV + 1.0, 20.0);
			double z = pos.z - fallV;
			if (z <= floorz)
			{
				z = floorz;
				SetPhase(PH_REST);
				A_StartSound("ubqs/drop", CHAN_BODY);
				A_StartSound(UBQS_Font.Off(), CHAN_AUTO);
			}
			SetOrigin((pos.xy, z), true);
			break;
		}
		case PH_REST:
			// lying flat and dark; walk over it to take it back
			if (Distance2D(master) < master.radius + 24 && abs(master.pos.z - pos.z) < 48) { Catch(); return; }
			if (pos.z > floorz + 0.5) { fallV = 0; SetPhase(PH_FALL); }
			break;
		}
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		Look();
		if (!IsLit()) return;
		if (age % 9 == 1) A_StartSound("ubqs/spin", CHAN_BODY, 0, 0.8);
		SpinCut();
		SpinDeflect();
		BurnTrail();
	}

	// ONE STEP: up or down first (clamped to the room), then across with TryMove, which walls stop and
	// monsters (+THRUACTORS) do not. False when a wall stopped it.
	private bool Fly(Vector3 step)
	{
		double z = clamp(pos.z + step.z, floorz, max(floorz, ceilingz - height));
		bool hitFlat = !bNoClip && abs((pos.z + step.z) - z) > 0.5;
		SetZ(z);
		if (!TryMove(pos.xy + step.xy, true)) return false;
		if (hitFlat) { Bang(); return false; }
		return true;
	}
	// A WALL OR THE FLOOR IN THE WAY: a clang, at most every few tics (no sparks -- the owner, 10-01)
	private int bangQuiet;
	private void Bang()
	{
		if (level.maptime - bangQuiet < 6) return;
		bangQuiet = level.maptime;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/wall", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.7);
	}

	private void Catch()
	{
		Glow(false);
		ClearRoute();
		if (launcher) launcher.Caught();
		Destroy();
	}

	// THE BLADE'S DIRECTION as it is drawn this tic (the model's +X), from its angle and pitch
	Vector3 BladeVec() { return (cos(pitch) * cos(angle), cos(pitch) * sin(angle), -sin(pitch)); }

	// THE LOOK: lit and spinning in the air, still and dark at rest.
	private void Look()
	{
		double spin = UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_throw_spin", 14.0);
		if (phase == PH_REST) { pitch = 0; roll = 0; }
		else
		{
			double rate = (phase == PH_FALL) ? spin * max(0.0, 1.0 - phaseAge / 25.0) : spin;
			spinPhase += rate;
			if (vertical) { angle = VectorAngle(dir.x, dir.y); pitch = spinPhase; }
			else { angle = spinPhase; pitch = (phase == PH_FALL) ? pitch * 0.85 : -6.0; }
		}
		String sn = String.Format("U%s%sT", UBQS_Data.Col(col), dbl ? "D" : "S");
		sprite = GetSpriteIndex(sn);
		frame = IsLit() ? 0 : 1;
		Glow(IsLit());
	}

	// ONE ATTACHED LIGHT while lit (none when ubqs_lights is 0), re-attached only when it changes
	private void Glow(bool on)
	{
		int rgb = 0, rad = 0;
		if (on && UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_lights", 1) > 0) { rgb = UBQS_Data.Rgb(col); rad = int(24.0 + bladeLen * 0.9) / 4 * 4; }
		if (rgb == litRgb && rad == litRad) return;
		litRgb = rgb;
		litRad = rad;
		A_RemoveLight('UBQS');
		if (rad > 0) A_AttachLight('UBQS', DynamicLight.PointLight, rgb, rad, 0, DynamicLight.LF_ATTENUATE);
	}

	// THE TRAIL: a blade that reaches a wall, the floor or the ceiling as it spins scorches it (no sparks --
	// the owner, 10-01). One trace per blade per tic; one scorch every three tics at most (decals are not free).
	private void BurnTrail()
	{
		if (!UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_burn", 1)) return;
		Vector3 b = BladeVec();
		BurnAlong(b);
		if (dbl) BurnAlong(-b);
	}
	private void BurnAlong(Vector3 d)
	{
		let tr = new("UBQS_Tracer");
		if (!tr.Trace(pos, CurSector, d, bladeLen, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, true)) return;
		int ht = tr.Results.HitType;
		if (ht == TRACE_HitNone || ht == TRACE_HitActor) return;
		if (burnQuiet > 0) return;
		burnQuiet = 3;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/burn", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.6);
		A_SprayDecal("UBQS_Burn", bladeLen + 8.0, (0, 0, 0), d);
		if (ht == TRACE_HitWall) UBQS_FX.Fx(tr.Results.HitPos - d * 1.5, 'UXEM', 1, 18, 0.14, 0.8, -1, 0.97);
	}

	// THE SPINNING BLADE: a disc as wide as the blade is long, around wherever it is
	private void SpinCut()
	{
		double reach = bladeLen;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.Create(self, reach + 32.0);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == master || mo == self || !mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0) continue;
			if (mo.bFriendly && master.player) continue;
			if (mo.player && !deathmatch) continue;
			if (Distance2D(mo) > reach + mo.radius) continue;
			double mz = mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5;
			if (abs(mz - pos.z) > mo.height * 0.5 + reach * (vertical ? 1.0 : 0.3)) continue;
			int i = cutWho.Find(mo);
			if (i < cutWho.Size() && level.maptime - cutWhen[i] < 10) continue;
			// UBQS_Thrown is an Actor, not Inventory: there is no UF()/UInt() here, only UBQS_Data.F(master,
			// ...). ubqs_dmg_thrown was a bare 1.5 -- the hardest-hitting attack in the mod, against the
			// swing's 0.5-2.0 and the twirl's 0.8, with ubqs_damage moving all three together.
			int dmg = int(UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_damage", 30.0) * UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_dmg_thrown", 1.5));
			if (!mo.bNoBlood) mo.SpawnBlood((mo.pos.xy, mz), angle, dmg);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, master, dmg, 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
			A_StartSound(mo.bNoBlood ? "ubqs/wall" : "ubqs/hit", CHAN_AUTO, 0, UBQS_Data.F(master, "ubqs_vol_hit", 1.0));
			if (phase == PH_ROUTE && leg < route.Size() && route[leg] == mo) legHit = true;
			if (i < cutWho.Size()) cutWhen[i] = level.maptime;
			else { cutWho.Push(mo); cutWhen.Push(level.maptime); }
		}
		for (int k = cutWho.Size() - 1; k >= 0; k--)
			if (!cutWho[k] || cutWho[k].health <= 0) { cutWho.Delete(k); cutWhen.Delete(k); }
	}
	private void SpinDeflect()
	{
		if (!UBQS_Data.I(master, "ubqs_deflect", 1)) return;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.Create(self, bladeLen + 64.0);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || !mo.bMissile || mo == self || mo.target == master || mo is "UBQS_Thrown") continue;
			if (Distance3D(mo) < bladeLen + mo.radius) launcher.BatBack(mo, BladeVec());
		}
	}

	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBST A -1;
		Stop;
	}
}

// ---- THE LOCK MARK: a diamond over each enemy you painted ------------------------------------------------
class UBQS_LockMark : Actor
{
	Actor who;          // the saber it was painted for
	Default
	{
		Scale 0.35;
		Alpha 0.95;
		RenderStyle "Add";
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+BRIGHT
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+FORCEXYBILLBOARD
	}
	static void MarkFor(Actor saber, Actor target)
	{
		if (!target) return;
		let m = UBQS_LockMark(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_LockMark", (target.pos.xy, target.pos.z + target.height + 8)));
		if (m) { m.tracer = target; m.who = saber; }
	}
	static void ClearAll(Actor saber)
	{
		let it = ThinkerIterator.Create("UBQS_LockMark");
		UBQS_LockMark m;
		while (m = UBQS_LockMark(it.Next()))
			if (!saber || m.who == saber) m.Destroy();
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Super.Tick();
		if (!who || !tracer || tracer.health <= 0) { Destroy(); return; }
		SetOrigin((tracer.pos.xy, tracer.pos.z + tracer.height + 8), true);
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBLK ABCD 3 Bright;
		Loop;
	}
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE FORCE: one item every saber-carrier holds. It owns the push (both hands share its cooldown), and reads
// the OFF HAND's gestures -- the off-hand saber's alt held, or with no off-hand saber the bare Force hand's
// trigger -- and the Force jump.
//   THRUST the hand out, held:  PUSH (along your thrust).
//   YANK it back to you, held:  PULL -- enemies stagger in, pickups fly to your hand, a thrown saber comes home.
//   HOLD it still on an enemy:  GRIP -- it rises, choking, and hangs where your hand points; move your hand and
//                               it moves; let go mid-swing and it is FLUNG (and hurts when it hits).
//   HOLD JUMP:                  a FORCE JUMP -- higher, and a floating fall while jump stays held.
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Force : Inventory
{
	int pushReady;
	Vector3 h0, h1, h2, h3;
	double lastYaw;
	Vector3 lastBody;
	bool armed, fired;
	int armTics, lastScan;
	// the grip
	Actor gripped;
	Actor aimedAt;                 // what a grab WOULD take, while the hand is armed
	UBQS_GripGlow aimGlow;         // its outline, dimmer than a held grip's
	int aimTic;
	UBQS_GripGlow gripGlow;
	double gripDist, dmgAcc;
	bool gripNoGrav;
	State gripPain;
	int gripSince;
	// a flung body, watched for the moment it hits something
	Actor slamMo;
	int slamTics;
	double slamLast;
	// things pulled toward you
	Array<Actor> pulled;
	Array<int> pulledUntil;
	// the jump
	int airTics;
	bool boostOk;

	Default
	{
		Inventory.MaxAmount 1;
		+INVENTORY.UNDROPPABLE
		+INVENTORY.UNTOSSABLE
		+INVENTORY.UNCLEARABLE
	}
	static UBQS_Force Of(Actor who)
	{
		if (!who) return null;
		let f = UBQS_Force(who.FindInventory("UBQS_Force"));
		if (!f) f = UBQS_Force(who.GiveInventoryType("UBQS_Force"));
		return f;
	}
	double FV(String n, double fb) { return UBQS_Data.F(owner, n, fb); }
	int IV(String n, int fb) { return UBQS_Data.I(owner, n, fb); }

	// ---- THE OFF HAND ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Vector3 OffPos()
	{
		Vector3 p = owner.OffhandPos;
		if (p == (0, 0, 0)) p = owner.Vec3Offset(0, 0, owner.player ? owner.player.viewheight * 0.8 : 40.0);
		return p;
	}
	Vector3 OffAim()
	{
		double a = owner.OffhandAngle + 90.0, p = -owner.OffhandPitch;
		return (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
	}
	Vector3 ViewFwd()
	{
		double a = owner.angle, p = owner.pitch;
		return (cos(p) * cos(a), cos(p) * sin(a), -sin(p));
	}
	Vector3 HandVel()
	{
		Vector3 a = h0 - h1, b = h1 - h2, c = h2 - h3;
		Vector3 v = a;
		if (b.Length() > v.Length()) v = b;
		if (c.Length() > v.Length()) v = c;
		return v;
	}
	void Buzz()
	{
		if (owner && owner.player && IV("ubqs_haptics", 1)) owner.LineAttack(owner.angle, 1, -90, 1, 'UBQS_Haptic', 'UBQS_HapticPuff', 256);
	}

	override void DoEffect()
	{
		Super.DoEffect();
		if (!owner || !owner.player || owner.health <= 0) { if (gripped) EndGrip(false); return; }
		// ubqs_force: THE MASTER SWITCH. Off, there is no Force in the mod -- no push, no pull, no
		// choke, no jump, no target outline, no hand flare, nothing still drifting from a pull.
		// Everything above reaches the player through this one method, so this is the only gate it
		// needs, bar Push() -- the main hand calls that directly and never comes through here.
		// A grip already held is RELEASED, not frozen: a monster left hanging in the air with its
		// gravity switched off is the worst possible way to turn a feature off.
		if (!IV("ubqs_force", 1))
		{
			if (gripped) EndGrip(false);
			AimTick(false);
			return;
		}
		let p = owner.player;
		// the off hand's last four positions, less the body; a snap turn or teleport forgets them
		h3 = h2; h2 = h1; h1 = h0;
		h0 = OffPos() - UBQS_SaberBase.BodyAt(owner);
		if (abs(DeltaAngle(lastYaw, owner.angle)) >= FV("ubqs_snap_turn_deg", 8.0) || (owner.pos - lastBody).Length() > 48.0) { h1 = h0; h2 = h0; h3 = h0; }
		lastYaw = owner.angle;
		lastBody = owner.pos;

		let off = p.OffhandWeapon;
		bool forceHand = off is "UBQS_ForceHand";
		int bits = 0;
		if (forceHand) bits = BT_OFFHANDATTACK | BT_OFFHANDALTATTACK;
		else if (off is "UBQS_SaberOff" && IV("ubqs_force_gestures", 1) && !UBQS_SaberBase(off).merged) bits = BT_OFFHANDALTATTACK;
		bool held = bits != 0 && (p.cmd.buttons & bits);

		if (gripped) GripTick(held);
		else if (held)
		{
			if (!armed) { armed = true; fired = false; armTics = 0; }
			armTics++;
			if (!fired) Gesture();
		}
		else armed = false;
		AimTick(bits != 0 && !gripped);
		// A FLARE ON THE HAND WHILE THE FORCE IS UP. With the target outline this is the whole feedback
		// loop: the hand says the gesture is live, the outline says what it would take. Every 4 tics so
		// it reads as a steady glow rather than a flicker.
		if (bits != 0 && (armed || gripped) && (level.maptime % 4) == 0)
			UBQS_FX.Fx(OffPos(), 'UXFH', 18, 1, gripped ? 0.085 : 0.055, gripped ? 0.75 : 0.45,
				gripped ? 0xFFC860 : 0xBFE0FF, 1.0);

		SlamTick();
		PulledTick();
		ForceJump(p);     // ubqs_force_jump is the only gate -- see ForceJump
	}

	// ---- READING THE HAND ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	private void Gesture()
	{
		Vector3 hv = HandVel();
		double sp = hv.Length();
		double thr = FV("ubqs_force_gesture", 2.0);
		Vector3 fwd = ViewFwd();
		// ubqs_gesture_straight: ubqs_force_gesture says how FAST the hand must move, this says how STRAIGHT,
		// and only the first was exposed. 0.55 is about 57 degrees off the view forward -- wide enough that a
		// sideways sweep reads as a push, which is where accidental Force use lives. The band between +g and
		// -g is the dead zone where a gesture does nothing at all and the player is told nothing. Exposed as
		// the dot it is: the cosine of no round number of degrees is 0.55.
		double gstr = clamp(FV("ubqs_gesture_straight", 0.55), 0.0, 1.0);
		if (sp >= thr)
		{
			Vector3 u = hv / sp;
			double dd = u dot fwd;
			if (dd >= gstr) { Push(OffPos(), (u + fwd).Unit()); fired = true; return; }
			if (dd <= -gstr) { Pull(OffPos(), (OffAim() + fwd).Unit()); fired = true; return; }
		}
		// Held still: reach for something to grip. A hand in VR is never truly still, so a player whose tremor
		// stays above ubqs_grip_still can never grip anything and has no way to find out why. ubqs_grip_hold is
		// how long he must hold it; tune the two as a pair.
		if (armTics >= max(IV("ubqs_grip_hold", 8), 1) && sp < FV("ubqs_grip_still", 1.5) && level.maptime - lastScan >= 3)
		{
			lastScan = level.maptime;
			let t = FindGrip();
			if (t) { StartGrip(t); fired = true; }
		}
	}

	// ---- PUSH ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	// Everything in a cone in front of the hand is thrown back -- the lighter it is the farther -- and knocked
	// about; shots in the cone are turned round. A shock ring rolls out along the cone (particles: no light).
	void Push(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d)
	{
		// the main hand reaches this through ForcePush(), never through DoEffect, so it needs its own gate
		if (!owner || !IV("ubqs_force", 1)) return;
		if (level.maptime < pushReady) { owner.A_StartSound(UBQS_Font.Off(), CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.25); return; }
		pushReady = level.maptime + int(FV("ubqs_push_cooldown", 1.5) * 35);
		// ubqs_push_cone: power and reach were both sliders and the SHAPE was baked at 80 degrees of total arc.
		// A narrow focused shove and a wide room-clearing blast are different abilities.
		// ubqs_vol_force: this sample is a sub-bass thump played at full volume on the default alt button --
		// the loudest thing in the mod by a wide margin.
		double range = FV("ubqs_push_range", 448.0), cone = clamp(FV("ubqs_push_cone", 40.0), 5.0, 90.0);
		double pwr = FV("ubqs_push_power", 1.0);
		double pdmg = FV("ubqs_push_damage", 8.0);
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/push", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0 * FV("ubqs_vol_force", 1.0));
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z - range, range * 2.0, range, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || mo is "UBQS_Thrown" || mo is "UBQS_Light" || mo is "UBQS_Remote") continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(hp, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < 1 || dist > range) continue;
			Vector3 u = to / dist;
			if (acos(clamp(u dot d, -1.0, 1.0)) > cone) continue;
			if (mo.bMissile)
			{
				if (mo.target == owner) continue;
				double sp = max(mo.Speed, mo.vel.Length());
				Actor shooter = mo.target;
				mo.target = owner;
				if (mo.bSeekerMissile) mo.tracer = shooter;
				mo.vel = u * max(sp, 8.0);
				mo.angle = VectorAngle(u.x, u.y);
				mo.pitch = -asin(clamp(u.z, -1.0, 1.0));
				continue;
			}
			if (!mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bDontThrust || (mo.player && !deathmatch) || (mo.bFriendly && owner.player)) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			double falloff = 1.0 - dist / range * 0.6;
			double f = clamp(2400.0 / max(mo.Mass, 50), 2.0, 26.0) * falloff * pwr;
			mo.vel += (u.x * f, u.y * f, max(u.z * f, 0.0) + f * 0.3);
			mo.DamageMobj(self, owner, int(pdmg), 'Saber', DMG_THRUSTLESS);
		}
		Ring(hp, d, 1.0);
		// DUST DOWN THE CONE. Three sheets at increasing distance, each wider and fainter, so the shove
		// has a shape and a direction rather than one ring at the hand. RS_Main's 18-frame blast smoke.
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
		{
			double at = 70.0 + i * 90.0;
			if (at > range) break;
			Vector3 side = (-d.y, d.x, 0);
			if (side.Length() > 0.01) side = side.Unit();
			for (int k = -1; k <= 1; k++)
				UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + d * at + side * (k * at * 0.26)
					+ (0, 0, frandom[UBQSFx](-8.0, 8.0)),
					'UXPD', 18, 1, 0.22 + 0.16 * i, 0.5 - 0.12 * i, 0xCBD8EA, 1.05);
		}
		Buzz();
	}
	// the shock ring: out along the cone (dir 1) or rushing in to the hand (dir -1)
	void Ring(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d, double dir)
	{
		// the CombatFX shockwave ring, pale blue: rolling out (push) or rushing in (pull)
		bool rev = dir < 0;
		UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + d * (rev ? 60.0 : 36.0), 'UXRG', 17, 1, 0.3, 0.85, 0xB8D8FF, rev ? 0.97 : 1.03, rev);
		UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + d * (rev ? 150.0 : 110.0), 'UXRG', 17, 1, 0.6, 0.6, 0xB8D8FF, rev ? 0.97 : 1.03, rev);
	}

	// ---- PULL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	void Pull(Vector3 hp, Vector3 d)
	{
		if (level.maptime < pushReady) { owner.A_StartSound(UBQS_Font.Off(), CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.25); return; }
		pushReady = level.maptime + int(FV("ubqs_push_cooldown", 1.5) * 35);
		owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/pull", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 1.0 * FV("ubqs_vol_force", 1.0));
		// your sabers, wherever they are, come home
		for (let item = owner.Inv; item; item = item.Inv)
		{
			let sb = UBQS_SaberBase(item);
			if (sb && sb.thrown) sb.thrown.Recall();
		}
		// ubqs_pull_cone: pull is how a room of pickups gets vacuumed, so the cone is the difference between
		// hoovering and picking one item -- and it was 30 against push's 40, hardcoded, invisible.
		// ubqs_pull_power: there was NO pull strength cvar; pull borrowed ubqs_push_power, so a strong yank with
		// a gentle shove was impossible and the menu never said the push slider moved both. 1.0 is identical to
		// today. Both read above the iterator.
		double range = FV("ubqs_pull_range", 768.0), cone = clamp(FV("ubqs_pull_cone", 30.0), 5.0, 90.0);
		double pwr = FV("ubqs_push_power", 1.0) * FV("ubqs_pull_power", 1.0);
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z - range, range * 2.0, range, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || mo.bMissile || mo is "UBQS_Thrown" || mo is "UBQS_Light" || mo is "UBQS_Remote") continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(hp, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < 1 || dist > range) continue;
			Vector3 u = to / dist;
			if (acos(clamp(u dot d, -1.0, 1.0)) > cone) continue;
			let inv = Inventory(mo);
			if (inv)
			{
				if (inv.Owner || !inv.bSpecial || pulled.Find(mo) < pulled.Size()) continue;
				if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
				pulled.Push(mo);
				pulledUntil.Push(level.maptime + 70);
				continue;
			}
			if (!mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bDontThrust || mo.player || (mo.bFriendly && owner.player)) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			double falloff = 1.0 - dist / range * 0.5;
			// THE CAP WAS THE CEILING, not the sliders: 22 before power meant a heavy monster shrugged off
			// any pull however high ubqs_pull_power went. 45 keeps mass mattering while leaving room for a
			// real yank. The lift goes 0.25 -> 0.45 so they come OFF THE FLOOR toward you instead of
			// skidding along it -- that arc is what reads as gravity gloves rather than a shove in reverse.
			double f = clamp(1800.0 / max(mo.Mass, 50), 2.0, 45.0) * falloff * pwr;
			mo.vel += (-u.x * f, -u.y * f, f * 0.45);
			UBQS_FX.Fx(mo.pos + (0, 0, mo.height * 0.5), 'UXFL', 13, 1, 0.14 + mo.radius * 0.003, 0.8, 0xBFE0FF, 1.03);
			// THE LINE OF FORCE, four arcs between it and your hand. Without this a pull is a noise and
			// then something arriving; with it you can see which one you have got hold of.
			for (int s = 1; s <= 4; s++)
				UBQS_FX.Fx(hp + to * (s / 5.0) + (0, 0, mo.height * 0.25),
					'UXFL', 13, 1, 0.07, 0.42, 0xBFE0FF, 1.0);
		}
		Ring(hp, d, -1.0);
		Buzz();
	}
	// pickups fly to you and are taken as they arrive
	private void PulledTick()
	{
		for (int i = pulled.Size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			let inv = Inventory(pulled[i]);
			if (!inv || inv.Owner || level.maptime > pulledUntil[i])
			{
				pulled.Delete(i);
				pulledUntil.Delete(i);
				continue;
			}
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(inv.pos, owner.pos + (0, 0, owner.height * 0.5));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < owner.radius + 16.0)
			{
				inv.Touch(owner);
				pulled.Delete(i);
				pulledUntil.Delete(i);
				continue;
			}
			inv.SetOrigin(inv.pos + to / dist * min(16.0, dist), true);
		}
	}

	// SHOW WHAT THE FORCE IS ON. The grab and the choke both take whatever FindGrip picks, and until
	// now nothing said which one that was -- so a grab that took the wrong monster, or nothing at all,
	// was indistinguishable from the gesture not registering. Same answer, same cone, same sight
	// check: this is the one it WOULD take, outlined while the hand is up.
	// Dimmer and slower than the held-grip glow (StartGrip spawns its own), so "could" and "have"
	// never look the same. Re-picked every 3 tics -- FindGrip walks a blockmap out to 1024 units and
	// that is not a per-tic cost worth paying for a hint.
	private void AimTick(bool on)
	{
		if (!on)
		{
			if (aimGlow) { aimGlow.Destroy(); aimGlow = null; }
			aimedAt = null;
			return;
		}
		if ((level.maptime % 3) == 0) aimedAt = FindGrip();
		if (!aimedAt || aimedAt.health <= 0)
		{
			if (aimGlow) { aimGlow.Destroy(); aimGlow = null; }
			aimedAt = null;
			return;
		}
		if (!aimGlow)
		{
			aimGlow = UBQS_GripGlow(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_GripGlow", aimedAt.pos));
			if (!aimGlow) return;
			aimGlow.SetShade(0xFFC860);      // warm, against the held grip's cold blue
			aimTic = 0;
		}
		aimTic++;
		aimGlow.Follow(aimedAt, owner, aimTic);
		aimGlow.alpha *= 0.55;             // a hint, not a hold
	}

	// ---- GRIP ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	private Actor FindGrip()
	{
		double maxMass = FV("ubqs_grip_mass", 600.0);
		if (maxMass <= 0) return null;
		Vector3 hp = OffPos(), aim = OffAim();
		// ubqs_grip_range / ubqs_grip_cone: push and pull both had reach sliders and grip had NONE, and 12
		// degrees at range is demanding for the fiddliest gesture in the mod -- this is the answer to "it never
		// grabs the one I want". ubqs_grip_boss: bBoss was excluded outright, so raising the mass slider to
		// 1000 still could not choke a Cyberdemon and nothing said so. Default 0 is exactly today.
		double range = clamp(FV("ubqs_grip_range", 1024.0), 128.0, 1536.0);
		double best = clamp(FV("ubqs_grip_cone", 12.0), 1.0, 60.0);
		bool boss = IV("ubqs_grip_boss", 0) != 0;
		Actor pick = null;
		let it = BlockThingsIterator.CreateFromPos(hp.x, hp.y, hp.z - range, range * 2.0, range, false);
		while (it.Next())
		{
			Actor mo = it.thing;
			if (!mo || mo == owner || !mo.bIsMonster || !mo.bShootable || mo.health <= 0 || mo.bFriendly || (mo.bBoss && !boss)) continue;
			if (mo.Mass > maxMass || mo.bDontThrust) continue;
			Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(hp, (mo.pos.xy, mo.pos.z + mo.height * 0.5));
			double dist = to.Length();
			if (dist < 1 || dist > range) continue;
			double off = acos(clamp((to / dist) dot aim, -1.0, 1.0));
			if (off >= best) continue;
			if (!owner.CheckSight(mo, SF_IGNOREVISIBILITY)) continue;
			best = off;
			pick = mo;
		}
		return pick;
	}
	private void StartGrip(Actor mo)
	{
		gripped = mo;
		gripDist = clamp(level.Vec3Diff(OffPos(), mo.pos).Length(), 56.0, 320.0);
		gripNoGrav = mo.bNoGravity;
		mo.bNoGravity = true;
		gripPain = mo.FindState("Pain");
		gripSince = level.maptime;
		dmgAcc = 0;
		// A HARD ARC THE MOMENT IT TAKES HOLD. The choke had a sound and an outline and nothing that
		// said FORCE. RS_Main's 13-frame lightning, over the victim's middle.
		UBQS_FX.Fx(mo.pos + (0, 0, mo.height * 0.55), 'UXFL', 13, 1, 0.22 + mo.radius * 0.004, 0.95, 0xCFE4FF, 1.04);
		// ubqs_snd_choke: the loop only. A_StopSound in EndGrip stays unconditional, so turning this
		// off part-way through a grip still silences the loop that is already running.
		if (IV("ubqs_snd_choke", 1))
			owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/grip", 23, CHANF_LOOPING, 0.7 * FV("ubqs_vol_force", 1.0));
		if (gripGlow) gripGlow.Destroy();
		gripGlow = UBQS_GripGlow(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_GripGlow", mo.pos));
		if (gripGlow) gripGlow.Follow(mo, owner, 0);
		mo.A_StartSound(mo.PainSound, CHAN_VOICE);
		if (gripPain) mo.SetState(gripPain);
		Buzz();
	}
	private void GripTick(bool held)
	{
		let mo = gripped;
		// AND KEEPS CRACKLING while it is held, every 5 tics at a random point on the body -- one flash
		// and then nothing for as long as you hold it read as the choke having stopped.
		if (mo && (level.maptime % 5) == 0)
			UBQS_FX.Fx(mo.pos + (frandom[UBQSFx](-1.0, 1.0) * mo.radius * 0.7,
			                     frandom[UBQSFx](-1.0, 1.0) * mo.radius * 0.7,
			                     mo.height * frandom[UBQSFx](0.25, 0.85)),
				'UXFL', 13, 1, 0.10 + mo.radius * 0.0025, 0.65, 0xCFE4FF, 1.02);
		if (!mo || mo.health <= 0) { EndGrip(false); return; }
		if (!held) { EndGrip(true); return; }
		// it hangs where your hand points, lifted a little, and follows the hand
		Vector3 want = OffPos() + OffAim() * gripDist + (0, 0, 10.0 - mo.height * 0.5);
		Vector3 dv = level.Vec3Diff(mo.pos, want);
		double l = dv.Length();
		Vector3 v = dv * 0.25;
		if (v.Length() > 14.0) v = v.Unit() * 14.0;
		mo.vel = v;
		// it can do nothing but struggle: its frame is held, and every so often it chokes
		if (mo.tics >= 0 && mo.tics < 2) mo.tics = 2;
		int t = level.maptime - gripSince;
		if (t > 0 && (t % 18) == 0)
		{
			mo.A_StartSound(mo.PainSound, CHAN_VOICE);
			if (gripPain) mo.SetState(gripPain);
			if (mo.tics >= 0 && mo.tics < 2) mo.tics = 2;
		}
		if ((t % 12) == 0) Buzz();
		// the choke
		dmgAcc += FV("ubqs_grip_damage", 18.0) / 35.0;
		if (dmgAcc >= 1.0)
		{
			int dmg = int(dmgAcc);
			dmgAcc -= dmg;
			mo.DamageMobj(self, owner, dmg, 'Force', DMG_NO_PAIN | DMG_THRUSTLESS);
			if (!mo || mo.health <= 0) { EndGrip(false); return; }
		}
		if (gripGlow) gripGlow.Follow(mo, owner, level.maptime - gripSince);
		// the Force about it: the CombatFX plasma pulse wrapped round its body
		if ((t % 6) == 0) UBQS_FX.Fx(mo.pos + (0, 0, mo.height * 0.5), 'UXPL', 6, 1, mo.radius * 2.6 / 56.0, 0.45);
	}
	private void EndGrip(bool fling)
	{
		let mo = gripped;
		gripped = null;
		if (owner) owner.A_StopSound(23);
		if (gripGlow) gripGlow.Destroy();
		gripGlow = null;
		if (!mo) return;
		mo.bNoGravity = gripNoGrav;
		if (mo.tics > 1) mo.tics = 1;
		if (fling && mo.health > 0)
		{
			Vector3 hv = HandVel();
			Vector3 v = hv * FV("ubqs_grip_fling", 3.5);
			if (v.Length() > 40.0) v = v.Unit() * 40.0;
			mo.vel += v;
			slamMo = mo;
			slamTics = 40;
			slamLast = mo.vel.Length();
			if (v.Length() > 6.0) owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/push", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.5 * FV("ubqs_vol_force", 1.0), ATTN_NORM, 1.4);
		}
	}
	// a flung body that stops dead has hit something: it hurts, as hard as it was going
	private void SlamTick()
	{
		if (!slamMo) return;
		if (--slamTics <= 0 || slamMo.health <= 0) { slamMo = null; return; }
		double sp = slamMo.vel.Length();
		if (slamLast > 9.0 && sp < slamLast * 0.4)
		{
			int dmg = int(slamLast * FV("ubqs_grip_slam", 3.0));
			slamMo.A_StartSound("ubqs/drop", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.8, ATTN_NORM, 0.6);
			slamMo.DamageMobj(self, owner, dmg, 'Force');
			slamMo = null;
			return;
		}
		slamLast = sp;
	}

	// ---- FORCE JUMP ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	private void ForceJump(PlayerInfo p)
	{
		if (!IV("ubqs_force_jump", 1)) return;
		bool jump = (p.cmd.buttons & BT_JUMP) != 0;
		if (p.onground) { airTics = 0; boostOk = jump; return; }
		airTics++;
		if (!jump) { boostOk = false; return; }
		double pw = FV("ubqs_jump_power", 1.0);
		// ubqs_jump_hold is the whole HEIGHT of a Force jump -- ubqs_jump_power only changes the rate inside the
		// window, so a genuinely big leap needs this and not the power slider. ubqs_jump_float decouples the
		// glide from the height: today raising the power makes you fall FASTER, which nothing said.
		if (boostOk && owner.vel.z > 0 && airTics <= max(IV("ubqs_jump_hold", 8), 1))
		{
			owner.vel.z += 0.55 * pw;
			if (airTics == 1) owner.A_StartSound("ubqs/push", CHAN_AUTO, 0, 0.35 * FV("ubqs_vol_force", 1.0), ATTN_NORM, 1.6);
		}
		else
		{
			double fl = -5.0 / max(pw * FV("ubqs_jump_float", 1.0), 0.25);
			if (owner.vel.z < fl) owner.vel.z = fl;        // a floating fall
		}
	}

	override void DetachFromOwner()
	{
		if (gripped) EndGrip(false);
		if (aimGlow) { aimGlow.Destroy(); aimGlow = null; }
		Super.DetachFromOwner();
	}
}

// WHAT YOU HOLD IN THE GRIP (the owner, 10-01: "a way to tell what i'm currently choking or grabbing ...
// breathe a different tint on and off slowly"). The engine has no tint for a sprite, so this is a twin: the
// gripped thing's own sprite and frame, laid over it a hair toward you, drawn as a Force-blue silhouette whose
// glow breathes in and out about once every two seconds.
class UBQS_GripGlow : Actor
{
	Default
	{
		RenderStyle "AddStencil";
		Alpha 0.0;
		Radius 1;
		Height 1;
		+NOINTERACTION
		+NOBLOCKMAP
		+NOGRAVITY
		+NOTONAUTOMAP
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTELEPORT
		+BRIGHT
	}
	override void PostBeginPlay()
	{
		Super.PostBeginPlay();
		SetShade(0x5AA0FF);
	}
	void Follow(Actor mo, Actor viewer, int t)
	{
		if (!mo) return;
		Vector3 at = mo.pos;
		if (viewer)
		{
			Vector2 to = level.Vec2Diff(mo.pos.xy, viewer.pos.xy);
			if (to.Length() > 1.0) at.xy += to.Unit() * 1.5;
		}
		Prev = pos;                    // it has no Tick of its own: it slides from last tic's spot, like its host
		SetOrigin(at, true);
		sprite = mo.sprite;
		frame = mo.frame;
		angle = mo.angle;
		scale = mo.scale;
		bXFlip = mo.bXFlip;
		bYFlip = mo.bYFlip;
		SpriteOffset = mo.SpriteOffset;
		alpha = 0.15 + 0.35 * (0.5 - 0.5 * cos(t * 6.0));
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		// held up by its Force item; it does nothing of its own
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		TNT1 A -1;
		Stop;
	}
}

// THE BARE FORCE HAND: with no off-hand saber (ubqs_dual off), the off hand holds nothing but the Force.
// Its trigger and its alt are both the Force's gestures (UBQS_Force reads them).
class UBQS_ForceHand : Weapon
{
	Default
	{
		+WEAPON.OFFHANDWEAPON
		+WEAPON.NOALERT
		+WEAPON.AMMO_OPTIONAL
		+WEAPON.NOAUTOFIRE
		+WEAPON.CHEATNOTWEAPON
		Weapon.SelectionOrder 9000;
		Tag "The Force";
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		TNT1 A -1;
		Stop;
	Select:
		UBFH A 1 A_Raise(20);
		Loop;
	Deselect:
		UBFH A 1 A_Lower(20);
		Loop;
	Ready:
		UBFH A 1 A_UBFHReady();
		Loop;
	Fire:
	AltFire:
		UBFH C 4 A_UBFHReady(false);
		Goto Ready;
	Register:
		UBFH B 0;
		Stop;
	}
	// ERMAC'S HAND (Rusted Legacy -- the owner, 10-01): relaxed at rest, OPEN while you reach with the Force,
	// a clenched FIST while you hold something in a grip
	action void A_UBFHReady(bool ready = true)
	{
		if (ready) A_WeaponReady();
		let f = UBQS_Force(FindInventory("UBQS_Force"));
		let psp = player.FindPSprite(PSP_OFFHANDWEAPON);
		if (!psp) return;
		psp.Frame = (f && f.gripped) ? 1 : ((f && f.armed) || !ready ? 2 : 0);
	}
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE TRAINING REMOTE (the Falcon, A New Hope): a little drone that circles in front of you and stings you
// with bolts for practice. Deflect them. ubqs_remote_level 1-3 sets how fast and how often; ubqs_remote_sting
// how much a hit hurts (0: not at all). It keeps score on screen. Summoned and dismissed from the menu, or
// `netevent ubqs_remote`.
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Remote : Actor
{
	Actor trainee;
	double th, om, rad, hgt;
	double radWant, hgtWant;   // where it has decided to be: see Tick
	int nextShot, windup, windupBase, nextChirp, omUntil;
	int shots, deflects, stung, struck;

	Default
	{
		Radius 5;
		Height 8;
		Health 1000;
		Mass 10;
		+NOGRAVITY
		+SHOOTABLE
		-SOLID
		+NOBLOOD
		+NOTARGET
		+DONTSPLASH
		+NOTAUTOAIMED
		+DONTTHRUST
		+NODAMAGETHRUST
		+FLOAT
		+NOBLOCKMONST
		Tag "Training remote";
	}
	int Level() { return clamp(UBQS_Data.I(trainee, "ubqs_remote_level", 2), 1, 3); }
	override void PostBeginPlay()
	{
		Super.PostBeginPlay();
		th = 0;
		om = 1.6;
		rad = 72;
		hgt = 0;
		nextShot = level.maptime + 70;
		nextChirp = level.maptime + 35;
	}
	void Report()
	{
		if (trainee) trainee.A_Print(String.Format("TRAINING REMOTE\ndeflected %d   stung %d   hit it %d", deflects, stung, struck), 2.0);
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		if (!trainee || !trainee.player) { Destroy(); return; }
		// THE DANCE: round you, out in front, drifting in and out and up and down
		if (level.maptime >= omUntil)
		{
			om = frandom[UBQSRem](0.8, 2.6) * (random[UBQSRem](0, 1) ? 1 : -1);
			omUntil = level.maptime + random[UBQSRem](25, 70);
			// a new place to be, re-rolled with the new direction: somewhere between in your face and
			// the far side of the room, at any height from your knees to above your head
			radWant = frandom[UBQSRem](72.0, 300.0);
			hgtWant = frandom[UBQSRem](-26.0, 42.0);
		}
		// ALL THE WAY ROUND. It used to bounce off +-70 degrees, so it never left the arc in front of
		// you -- you could stand still and face it the whole session.
		th += om;
		if (th >= 360.0) th -= 360.0;
		if (th < 0.0) th += 360.0;
		// IN AND OUT. Easing toward a target reads as the remote deciding to close or back off; the old
		// +-1.5 a tic inside a 44-unit band was a wobble you could not see.
		if (radWant <= 0) { radWant = frandom[UBQSRem](72.0, 300.0); hgtWant = frandom[UBQSRem](-26.0, 42.0); }
		rad = clamp(rad + clamp(radWant - rad, -3.5, 3.5), 56.0, 300.0);
		hgt = clamp(hgt + clamp(hgtWant - hgt, -1.6, 1.6), -26.0, 42.0);
		double a = trainee.angle + th;
		double eye = trainee.player.viewheight;
		Vector3 want = trainee.Vec3Offset(cos(a) * rad, sin(a) * rad, eye - 6.0 + hgt + sin(level.maptime * 9.0) * 2.0);
		Vector3 dv = level.Vec3Diff(pos, want);
		if (dv.Length() > 512.0) { SetOrigin(want, false); vel = (0, 0, 0); }
		else
		{
			Vector3 v = dv * 0.12;
			if (v.Length() > 14.0) v = v.Unit() * 14.0;   // it has three times as far to travel now
			vel = vel * 0.5 + v * 0.5;
		}
		Vector3 to = level.Vec3Diff(pos, trainee.pos + (0, 0, eye * 0.8));
		angle = VectorAngle(to.x, to.y);
		// THE SHOT: a beep, its lamps glow for a moment, then it stings
		if (windup > 0)
		{
			// min(windup, windupBase): the puff grows over the LEVEL's own telegraph length. Without this the
			// extra warning tics drive (12 - windup) through zero and negative, and UBQS_FX.Fx sets
			// scale = (sc, sc) unclamped -- so the warning the slider exists to lengthen would shrink to
			// nothing and then come back mirrored. At ubqs_remote_warn 0 this is identical to today.
			if ((windup & 1) == 0) UBQS_FX.Fx(pos + (0, 0, height * 0.5), 'UXRE', 1, 3, 0.04 + 0.006 * (12 - min(windup, max(windupBase, 1))), 0.9);
			if (--windup == 0) { Fire(); frame = 0; }
		}
		else if (trainee.health > 0 && level.maptime >= nextShot)
		{
			// ubqs_remote_warn: the windup IS the player's reaction window, and it was welded to the level --
			// you could not ask for fast bolts AND a fair warning, which is the whole point of a trainer.
			// UBQS_Remote is an Actor: UBQS_Data.I(trainee, ...), not UInt(). windupBase keeps the LEVEL's own
			// telegraph length, so the extra tics are a quiet early glow and the growing ramp still runs over
			// the last windupBase tics exactly as it does today.
			windupBase = 12 - Level() * 2;
			windup = windupBase + clamp(UBQS_Data.I(trainee, "ubqs_remote_warn", 0), 0, 20);
			frame = 1;
			A_StartSound("ubqs/rcharge", CHAN_BODY, 0, 0.7);
		}
		if (level.maptime >= nextChirp)
		{
			nextChirp = level.maptime + random[UBQSRem](60, 160);
			// A droid chirping every two to five seconds for a whole training session, with no off switch.
			// The RNG above stays unconditional; only the sound is scaled (0 = quiet). All three ubqs/rbeep
			// sites read this cvar, so 0 really does mean a quiet remote.
			A_StartSound("ubqs/rbeep", CHAN_VOICE, 0, 0.6 * UBQS_Data.F(trainee, "ubqs_remote_chirp", 1.0));
		}
	}
	void Fire()
	{
		if (!trainee) return;
		static const double SPD[] = { 7.0, 9.0, 12.0 };
		static const int GAPMIN[] = { 45, 30, 18 };
		static const int GAPMAX[] = { 90, 60, 40 };
		int L = Level() - 1;
		Vector3 at = trainee.pos + (frandom[UBQSRem](-8, 8), frandom[UBQSRem](-8, 8), trainee.height * frandom[UBQSRem](0.45, 0.85));
		Vector3 from = pos + (0, 0, height * 0.5);
		Vector3 d = level.Vec3Diff(from, at);
		if (d.Length() < 1) return;
		d = d.Unit();
		let b = UBQS_RemoteBolt(Spawn("UBQS_RemoteBolt", from + d * 6.0));
		if (b)
		{
			b.target = self;
			b.home = self;
			b.rgb = 0xFF3020;
			b.Speed = SPD[L];
			b.vel = d * SPD[L];
			b.angle = VectorAngle(d.x, d.y);
			b.pitch = -asin(clamp(d.z, -1.0, 1.0));
		}
		shots++;
		A_StartSound("ubqs/rfire", CHAN_WEAPON);
		nextShot = level.maptime + random[UBQSRem](GAPMIN[L], GAPMAX[L]);
	}
	override int DamageMobj(Actor inflictor, Actor source, int damage, Name mod, int flags, double angle)
	{
		// a deflected sting back into it: a point to you. A swat with the blade (or a shot): knocked away.
		if (inflictor is "UBQS_RemoteBolt")
		{
			struck++;
			Report();
			A_StartSound("ubqs/rsad", CHAN_VOICE);
		}
		else A_StartSound("ubqs/rbeep", CHAN_VOICE, 0, UBQS_Data.F(trainee, "ubqs_remote_chirp", 1.0));
		Vector3 kick = (frandom[UBQSRem](-1, 1), frandom[UBQSRem](-1, 1), frandom[UBQSRem](0, 1));
		if (source && source != self)
		{
			Vector3 away = level.Vec3Diff(source.pos, pos);
			if (away.Length() > 1) kick = away.Unit() + (0, 0, 0.3);
		}
		vel += kick * 8.0;
		nextShot = max(nextShot, level.maptime + 35);
		return 0;
	}
	States
	{
	Spawn:
		UBRM A -1;
		Stop;
	Register:
		UBRM B -1;
		Stop;
	}
}

class UBQS_RemoteBolt : UBQS_Bolt
{
	UBQS_Remote home;
	bool counted;
	Default
	{
		Speed 9;
		Radius 2;
		Height 3;
		DamageFunction (1);
		DamageType "Remote";
		Obituary "%o was stung by a training remote.";
	}
	override bool CanCollideWith(Actor other, bool passive)
	{
		if (passive) return true;
		bool back = target && target.player;          // deflected: it is yours now
		if (other is "UBQS_Remote") return back;
		if (other.player) return !back;
		return back && other.bShootable;
	}
	override int DoSpecialDamage(Actor victim, int damage, Name damagetype)
	{
		if (victim && victim.player && home && victim == home.trainee)
		{
			home.stung++;
			home.Report();
			return UBQS_Data.I(victim, "ubqs_remote_sting", 2);
		}
		if (victim is "UBQS_Remote") return 1;
		return 10;
	}
	override void Tick()
	{
		Super.Tick();
		if (bDestroyed) return;
		if (!counted && home && target && target.player)
		{
			counted = true;
			home.deflects++;
			home.Report();
		}
	}
}

// ==========================================================================================================
// THE BRIDGE: their saber becomes this one -- on the map, in your inventory, in your hand
// ==========================================================================================================
class UBQS_Bridge : EventHandler
{
	private int ximKnown;
	private int raisedAt[MAXPLAYERS];

	static bool On()
	{
		let c = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_on");
		return !c || c.GetBool();
	}
	// XIM'S STAR WARS DOOM is DeHackEd: its saber IS Doom's Chainsaw. Told apart by its own lump, XIMSWD,
	// or by its pickup line calling the chainsaw a lightsaber.
	private bool XimLoaded()
	{
		if (ximKnown == 0)
		{
			bool yes = Wads.CheckNumForName("XIMSWD", Wads.ns_global) >= 0;
			if (!yes)
			{
				String s = StringTable.Localize("$GOTCHAINSAW");
				s = s.MakeLower();
				yes = s.IndexOf("lightsaber") >= 0 || s.IndexOf("light saber") >= 0;
			}
			ximKnown = yes ? 1 : 2;
		}
		return ximKnown == 1;
	}
	// THE SABERS THIS ONE REPLACES: Wardust's Lightsaber, the earlier SW QuestSaber's, Xim's chainsaw-saber,
	// and Doom's own chainsaw if you ask for it (ubqs_chainsaw).
	private bool IsTheirs(class<Actor> c)
	{
		if (!c) return false;
		String n = c.GetClassName();
		if (n ~== "Lightsaber" || n ~== "SWSP_Saber") return true;
		if (n ~== "Chainsaw")
		{
			if (XimLoaded()) return true;
			let cc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_chainsaw");
			return cc && cc.GetBool();
		}
		return false;
	}

	// THE TRAINING REMOTE: `netevent ubqs_remote` (the menu's button) summons one for you, or sends yours away
	override void NetworkProcess(ConsoleEvent e)
	{
		// KEYS, NOT CVARS, so nothing here can go dead in his ini -- and NO KEYCONF alias either: a MENUDEF
		// Control row binds whatever command string it is given, and `netevent` is a plain CCMD (the shipped
		// menu already runs `netevent ubqs_remote` from a Command row), so "netevent ubqs_blade2" works as a
		// bind on its own.
		// `ubqs_blade2` lights or douses the SECOND blade on whichever sabers are in hand; `ubqs_ignite`
		// douses and relights them.
		// WHY keys and not cvars: A_UBAltFire returns early for the off hand whenever ubqs_force_gestures is on
		// (the default) BEFORE it reads ubqs_alt, so the off-hand saber could never light its second blade by
		// any input at all; and Twirling() needs `back`, which only ToggleBack sets, which only runs when
		// ubqs_alt is 0 -- so on a default profile the staff twirl could never happen, and ubqs_twirl and
		// ubqs_dmg_twirl were unreachable. One key fixes the off hand, the twirl and the alt-button clash
		// together, and the other gives Flick() -- the only writer of `doused` -- a real caller.
		if (e.Name ~== "ubqs_blade2" || e.Name ~== "ubqs_ignite")
		{
			if (e.Player < 0 || e.Player >= MAXPLAYERS || !playeringame[e.Player]) return;
			let who = players[e.Player].mo;
			if (!who) return;
			bool ign = e.Name ~== "ubqs_ignite";
			for (let item = who.Inv; item; item = item.Inv)
			{
				let sb = UBQS_SaberBase(item);
				if (!sb || !sb.InHand() || sb.thrown) continue;
				if (ign) sb.Flick();
				else sb.ToggleBack();
			}
			return;
		}
		if (!(e.Name ~== "ubqs_remote")) return;
		if (e.Player < 0 || e.Player >= MAXPLAYERS || !playeringame[e.Player]) return;
		let mo = players[e.Player].mo;
		if (!mo) return;
		let it = ThinkerIterator.Create("UBQS_Remote");
		UBQS_Remote r;
		bool had = false;
		while (r = UBQS_Remote(it.Next()))
		{
			if (r.trainee != mo) continue;
			r.Destroy();
			had = true;
		}
		if (had) { mo.A_Print("Training remote dismissed", 1.5); return; }
		let nr = UBQS_Remote(Actor.Spawn("UBQS_Remote", mo.Vec3Angle(64, mo.angle, mo.player.viewheight - 6.0)));
		if (nr)
		{
			nr.trainee = mo;
			nr.A_StartSound("ubqs/rbeep", CHAN_VOICE, 0, UBQS_Data.F(mo, "ubqs_remote_chirp", 1.0));
			mo.A_Print("Training remote: deflect its stings", 2.0);
		}
	}

	override void CheckReplacement(ReplaceEvent e)
	{
		if (!On() || e.IsFinal || !e.Replacee) return;
		if (IsTheirs(e.Replacee)) { e.Replacement = "UBQS_Saber"; e.IsFinal = true; }
	}

	// EVERY HITSCAN IN THE GAME passes through here, so it returns on the first few lines unless a
	// player is actually holding a lit blade. A PLAYER'S OWN SHOTS ARE NEVER TESTED -- not the gun in
	// their hand, not Buzz()'s own 1-unit trace, not the block's return bolt.
	override bool WorldHitscanPreFired(WorldEvent e)
	{
		Actor sh = e.Thing;
		if (!sh || sh.player || e.Damage <= 0 || !On()) return false;
		let hc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_hitscan_guard");
		if (hc && !hc.GetBool()) return false;
		double ca = cos(e.AttackPitch);
		Vector3 dir = (ca * cos(e.AttackAngle), ca * sin(e.AttackAngle), -sin(e.AttackPitch));
		// the muzzle, by P_LineAttack's own formula: the shooter's centre plus the attack's own z
		Vector3 from = (sh.pos.xy, sh.pos.z + sh.height * 0.5 + e.AttackZ);
		double dist = e.AttackDistance > 0 ? e.AttackDistance : 2048.0;
		for (int i = 0; i < MAXPLAYERS; i++)
		{
			if (!playeringame[i] || !players[i].mo || players[i].mo == sh) continue;
			for (let item = players[i].mo.Inv; item; item = item.Inv)
			{
				let sb = UBQS_SaberBase(item);
				if (sb && sb.StopsHitscan(sh, from, dir, dist, e.Damage)) return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	override void WorldTick()
	{
		if ((level.maptime % 5) != 0 || !On()) return;
		let dc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_dual");
		bool dual = !dc || dc.GetBool();
		let stc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_start");
		bool start = !stc || stc.GetBool();
		for (int i = 0; i < MAXPLAYERS; i++)
		{
			if (!playeringame[i] || !players[i].mo) continue;
			let p = players[i];
			// THE OFF-HAND RAISE LATCH IS PER LIFE, NOT PER LEVEL. PlayerPawn nulls BOTH hands on a
			// respawn (player.zs:1012) and only re-raises the main one, so a latch that survives death
			// leaves you one-handed for the rest of the map.
			if (p.health <= 0) { raisedAt[i] = 0; continue; }
			// THEIRS OUT, OURS IN: whatever their saber is, carried
			bool swapped = false, held = false;
			for (let item = p.mo.Inv; item; )
			{
				let next = item.Inv;
				let w = Weapon(item);
				if (w && !(w is "UBQS_SaberBase") && IsTheirs(w.GetClass()))
				{
					if (p.ReadyWeapon == w || p.PendingWeapon == w) held = true;
					if (p.OffhandWeapon == w) p.OffhandWeapon = null;
					p.mo.RemoveInventory(w);
					w.Destroy();
					swapped = true;
				}
				item = next;
			}
			if ((swapped || start) && !p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber")) p.mo.GiveInventory("UBQS_Saber", 1);
			if (held)
			{
				let ours = Weapon(p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber"));
				if (ours) p.PendingWeapon = ours;
			}
			// ...AND THE SLOTS AGREE WITH THE CLASSES. Pinning the flag is not enough on its own: if
			// the engine has left the MAIN saber sitting in the off hand's slot (or the off-hand one
			// in the main slot) the pair is inconsistent, and that is the mace windu. Clear the wrong
			// slot and the auto-equip below puts the right saber back on the next tic.
			// (UBQS_Saber and UBQS_SaberOff are SIBLINGS under UBQS_SaberBase, not parent and child,
			// so each `is` test here matches one class and not the other.)
			if (p.OffhandWeapon is "UBQS_Saber") p.OffhandWeapon = null;
			let mainSaber = Weapon(p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber"));
			// only ever ASK for the right weapon -- assigning a null PendingWeapon is not WP_NOCHANGE
			// and would stall the engine's weapon handling
			if (p.ReadyWeapon is "UBQS_SaberOff" && mainSaber) p.PendingWeapon = mainSaber;
			// THE SECOND SABER, for the off hand, while the server allows it and you carry the first
			if (dual && p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber") && !p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_SaberOff"))
				p.mo.GiveInventory("UBQS_SaberOff", 1);
			// THE FORCE goes with the saber; with no off-hand saber, the bare Force hand too (ubqs_force_hand)
			if (p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber") && !p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Force")) p.mo.GiveInventory("UBQS_Force", 1);
			// The UBQS_Force item is given either way, and sits inert while ubqs_force is 0, so the
			// switch works mid-game without a pickup. The bare Force HAND is a weapon in your off hand
			// and there is no reason to hold one when it cannot do anything.
			let fhc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_force_hand");
			let fmc = CVar.FindCVar("ubqs_force");
			bool fhand = !dual && (!fhc || fhc.GetBool()) && (!fmc || fmc.GetInt() != 0);
			if (fhand && p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber") && !p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_ForceHand"))
				p.mo.GiveInventory("UBQS_ForceHand", 1);
			// ONCE, not every 350 tics -- see the note above
			if (fhand && p.OffhandWeapon == null && p.PendingWeapon == WP_NOCHANGE && raisedAt[i] == 0)
			{
				raisedAt[i] = level.maptime;
				let fh = Weapon(p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_ForceHand"));
				if (fh && !(p.ReadyWeapon && p.ReadyWeapon.bTwoHanded))
				{
					fh.bOffhandWeapon = true;
					p.PendingWeapon = fh;
					p.mo.BringUpWeapon();
				}
			}
			// ...AND DRAWN. Owning an OFFHANDWEAPON is not holding it: QuestZDoom only puts a weapon in the off
			// hand when it is brought up as PendingWeapon (PlayerPawn.BringUpWeapon). With the off hand empty
			// and nothing else switching, bring ours up there.
			// ONCE, not every 350 tics -- see the note above
			// ...and re-armed whenever the slot is occupied, so switchhand 1 evicting the saber (it always
			// can) is a transition we come back from rather than a one-way door.
			if (p.OffhandWeapon != null) raisedAt[i] = 0;
			if (dual && p.OffhandWeapon == null && p.PendingWeapon == WP_NOCHANGE && raisedAt[i] == 0)
			{
				raisedAt[i] = level.maptime;
				let off = Weapon(p.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_SaberOff"));
				if (off && !(p.ReadyWeapon && p.ReadyWeapon.bTwoHanded))
				{
					off.bOffhandWeapon = true;
					p.PendingWeapon = off;
					p.mo.BringUpWeapon();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// ---- GLOW TELEMETRY (ubqs_diag 2, build 50): every rendered frame, the LIVE blade (the controller pose the
// hand layer is drawn from this frame, through the very same UBQS_Data.BladeDirOf / EmitAlong as the saber)
// against where the world glow is actually DRAWN this frame: lerp(Prev, Pos, FracTic), the angles lerped from
// the glow's own record of last tic's (pYaw / pPitch: PrevAngles is not in ZScript). One console line per frame
// (UBQSTEL ..., to the log only -- +logfile captures it, the view is not flooded) and a readout of the last full second's RMS / max. UI only READS play.
class UBQS_Telemetry : EventHandler
{
	ui double tLastMs;
	ui Vector3 tLastDir;
	ui bool tHave;
	ui double bStart, sA, sB, mA, mB;
	ui int bN;
	ui double rA, xA, rB, xB, rN;

	override void RenderOverlay(RenderEvent e)
	{
		let pl = players[consoleplayer];
		if (!pl || !pl.mo) return;
		let cv = CVar.GetCVar("ubqs_diag", pl);
		if (!cv || cv.GetInt() != 2) return;
		let s = UBQS_SaberBase(pl.mo.FindInventory("UBQS_Saber"));
		double now = MSTimeF();
		// THE WORLD HILT'S OWN RESIDUAL: how far the hilt you are holding sits from your real hand, in map
		// units, measured AT THE HAND. This is the number to judge ubqs_world_saber on, and it is NOT the
		// "base" figure below -- that one compares the HALO actor against the script's blade base, so it
		// carries a constant ubqs_glow_overlap_halo (default 1.5 u) bias and it is taken a lever-arm up the
		// blade, where angular lead error is multiplied. This one also works while the blade is doused, which
		// is exactly when the hilt is the only thing drawn.
		String hiltLine = "hilt: drawn in the hand layer";
		if (s && s.wsaber)
		{
			double la = pl.mo.AttackAngle + 90.0, lp = -pl.mo.AttackPitch, lr = pl.mo.AttackRoll;
			Vector3 lfw = (cos(lp) * cos(la), cos(lp) * sin(la), -sin(lp));
			Vector3 luz = UBQS_Data.GlowAxis(la, lp, lr);
			double lps = pl.mo.level ? pl.mo.level.pixelstretch : 1.2;
			Vector3 lwant = UBQS_Data.HandPosOf(pl.mo, false) + UBQS_Data.WorldNudge(lfw, luz, false, s.lastSizeIdx, lps);
			let w = s.wsaber;
			Vector3 wdrawn = w.Prev + (w.pos - w.Prev) * e.FracTic;
			hiltLine = String.Format("hilt vs real hand: %.2f u", (wdrawn - lwant).Length());
		}
		if (!s || !s.gHalo || pl.ReadyWeapon != s)
		{
			Screen.DrawText(SmallFont, Font.CR_GOLD, 8, 40, String.Format("UBQS telemetry: no lit main-hand glow  |  %s", hiltLine), DTA_VirtualWidth, 640, DTA_VirtualHeight, 400);
			return;
		}
		// THE LIVE BLADE: this frame's controller pose (the hand layer's)
		Vector3 hp = UBQS_Data.HandPosOf(pl.mo, false);
		Vector3 ldr = UBQS_Data.BladeDirOf(pl.mo.AttackAngle + 90.0, -pl.mo.AttackPitch, pl.mo.AttackRoll, s.frameNow, false);
		Vector3 lb = UBQS_Data.BladeBaseOf(hp, ldr, s.lastSizeIdx);
		Vector3 ld = ldr.Unit();
		double tf = System.GetTimeFrac();
		// THE DRAWN GLOW: what the renderer interpolates to this frame
		let g = s.gHalo;
		double fr = e.FracTic;
		Vector3 db = g.Prev + (g.pos - g.Prev) * fr;
		double dy = g.pYaw + Actor.DeltaAngle(g.pYaw, g.angle) * fr;
		double dp = g.pPitch + Actor.DeltaAngle(g.pPitch, g.pitch) * fr;
		double dr = g.pRoll + Actor.DeltaAngle(g.pRoll, g.roll) * fr;
		Vector3 dd = UBQS_Data.GlowAxis(dy, dp, dr);
		// (build 51) the facing: how far the eye the glow was turned to is off the real view position, seen
		// round the beam
		Vector3 fe = UBQS_Data.EyeOf(pl) - db, fr2 = e.ViewPos - db;
		fe -= dd * (fe dot dd);
		fr2 -= dd * (fr2 dot dd);
		double ef = (fe.Length() > 0.01 && fr2.Length() > 0.01) ? acos(clamp(fe.Unit() dot fr2.Unit(), -1.0, 1.0)) : 0.0;
		double ea = acos(clamp(dd.Unit() dot ld, -1.0, 1.0));
		double eb = (db - lb).Length();
		double ws = 0;
		if (tHave && now > tLastMs) ws = acos(clamp(ld dot tLastDir, -1.0, 1.0)) / (now - tLastMs) * 1000.0;
		tLastMs = now;
		tLastDir = ld;
		tHave = true;
		Console.PrintfEx(PRINT_LOG, "UBQSTEL %.1f f %.3f gtf %.3f live %.4f %.4f %.4f drawn %.4f %.4f %.4f err %.2f deg base %.2f u hand %.0f deg/s | tic: w %.0f still %d snapA %d snapL %d tauA %.1f tauL %.1f fade %.2f | face %.1f deg eye %.1f u",
			now, fr, tf, ld.x, ld.y, ld.z, dd.x, dd.y, dd.z, ea, eb, ws, s.gWs, s.gStill, s.gSnapA, s.gSnapL, s.gTauA, s.gTauL, s.gFade, ef, (UBQS_Data.EyeOf(pl) - e.ViewPos).Length());
		// the last full second
		if (now - bStart >= 1000.0 || now < bStart)
		{
			if (bN > 0) { rA = sqrt(sA / bN); xA = mA; rB = sqrt(sB / bN); xB = mB; rN = bN; }
			bStart = now; sA = 0; sB = 0; mA = 0; mB = 0; bN = 0;
		}
		sA += ea * ea; sB += eb * eb; mA = max(mA, ea); mB = max(mB, eb); bN++;
		Screen.DrawText(SmallFont, Font.CR_GREEN, 8, 40, String.Format("UBQS glow vs live blade, last 1 s (%d frames): angle RMS %.2f max %.2f deg | base RMS %.2f max %.2f u", int(rN), rA, xA, rB, xB), DTA_VirtualWidth, 640, DTA_VirtualHeight, 400);
		Screen.DrawText(SmallFont, Font.CR_GREEN, 8, 50, String.Format("now: err %.2f deg  base %.2f u  hand %.0f deg/s  lead %.1f / %.1f ms  %s", ea, eb, ws, s.gTauA, s.gTauL, s.gStill ? "STILL" : ""), DTA_VirtualWidth, 640, DTA_VirtualHeight, 400);
		Screen.DrawText(SmallFont, Font.CR_GREEN, 8, 60, hiltLine, DTA_VirtualWidth, 640, DTA_VirtualHeight, 400);
	}
}
